title: Recoverability and Verifier Strength: Two Measured Preconditions for Unattended Agent Self-Improvement
title_zh: 无人值守智能体自我改进的两项可测量前提：可恢复性与验证器强度

paragraphs.en: AgenticOS: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI
paragraphs.zh: AgenticOS：为智能体 AI 共同设计操作系统层的系统与机器学习基础

paragraphs.en: Agent platforms are starting to improve their own agents: they read a deployed agent’s execution traces, derive a change, have an automated verifier approve it, and release it with no human author. How much of this loop can safely run without a human? We propose two quantities a platform can measure. Verifier strength σ \sigma is how well the available verifier — often an LLM judge — agrees with a trusted reference verifier; it limits how much a step can improve the agent. Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone: whether undoing it needs a new verifier approval, and how much of the old behavior a rollback restores. A step should run unattended only if both are adequate. On our platform this rule allows prompt, tool and skill edits to run unattended and keeps weight updates under human sign-off.

paragraphs.en: Our main contribution is these two definitions and how to measure them. We built a platform that applies the rule and tested it in two ways: on the platform’s own approval gate, and in controlled experiments on the τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench agent benchmark. On verifier strength, the platform’s LLM judge sometimes gave the same score no matter what it was shown (9 of 37 settings) and reported no error, so a verifier can look healthy while approving anything; its strength must be measured, and two simple tests catch the failure. On recoverability, restoring a saved copy brought the agent back to its original behavior, but a regenerated undo did not, so only changes whose old version is kept can be reversed without a human; and while a change was deployed, it altered the outcome of 17 % 17\% of tasks beyond normal run-to-run variation, which no undo repairs. Together these support the rule: a change can run unattended only when its old version is kept and its verifier’s strength has been measured.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献是这两个定义以及如何对它们进行度量。 我们构建了一个应用该规则的平台，并通过两种方式进行测试：一是在平台自身的审批关卡上，二是在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 智能体基准上进行受控实验。 在验证器强度方面，平台的 LLM 裁判有时无论看到什么都会给出相同的评分（37 个设置中有 9 个），且不报告任何错误，因此一个验证器可能看起来运行正常，实际上却批准一切；验证器的强度必须经过度量，两个简单的测试就能发现这种失效。 在可恢复性方面，恢复已保存的副本可以让智能体回到其原始行为，但重新生成的撤销却不能；因此只有保留了旧版本的变更才能在无需人工干预的情况下被撤销；此外，某项变更在部署期间改变了 17 % 17\% 的任务结果，超出了正常的运行间波动范围，而任何撤销都无法修复这种影响。 这些共同支持了该规则：只有当变更的旧版本被保留且其验证器的强度经过度量时，该变更才能无人值守地运行。

paragraphs.en: Agents built on language models now hold conversations, call tools, and write to business systems ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2026 ) . They also fail often. On the τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench tasks we study the baseline agent solves just over half of its tasks, through ordinary mistakes: a wrong tool call, a missing confirmation, steps taken out of order ( Cuadron et al., 2026 ) . Fixing such failures means reading traces, finding the cause, revising the agent, checking the revision and deploying it. Done by hand, this does not scale with the number of agents a platform hosts, so platforms have begun to automate it ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li & Zhu, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于语言模型构建的智能体现在能够进行对话、调用工具并写入业务系统（Yao 等，2025；Barres 等，2026）。但它们也经常出错。 在我们研究的 τ^{2}-bench 任务上，基线智能体只完成了略过半数的任务，失败原因都是些寻常的错误：错误的工具调用、缺少确认、步骤顺序颠倒（Cuadron 等，2026）。 修复这类失败意味着阅读轨迹、找出原因、修改智能体、检查修改结果并部署。 若靠人工完成，这将无法随平台托管的智能体数量扩展，因此各平台已开始将其自动化（Wang 等，2026；Li 与 Zhu，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We call one pass of this automated repair a self-improvement step : the platform reads its own agents’ traces, derives a change, checks it with a verifier and deploys it, with no person writing the change. Inference-time self-correction ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) and human-written fixes do not count. Training and serving became platform services long ago ( Baylor et al., 2017 ; Moritz et al., 2018 ) ; this loop has not, yet it needs the same things: a budget, controlled access to the deployed agent, a point where changes are admitted, and an audit trail (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种自动化修复的一次执行称为一个自我改进步骤：平台读取自身智能体的轨迹，推导出一项变更，用验证器检查该变更并部署它，全程无人撰写变更。 推理时自我纠正（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023）和人工撰写的修复不算在内。 训练与推理服务早已成为平台服务（Baylor et al., 2017；Moritz et al., 2018）；这一循环却还没有，但它需要同样的东西：预算、对已部署智能体的受控访问、变更被准入的环节，以及审计追踪（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: This paper asks how much of the loop may run without a human. Our answer rests on two measurable quantities (§ 2 ). Verifier strength measures how far the verifier’s approvals can be trusted: its agreement with a reference verifier on a scale from − 1 -1 to 1 1 , where 1 1 is perfect agreement and a verifier that always gives the same answer scores 0 0 . Recoverability measures how cheaply a bad change is undone. It records whether undoing a change needs a new verifier approval and how much of the old behavior actually returns. If no copy of the old version was kept (for example, after fine-tuning a model in place), the undo must pass the same verifier that just approved the mistake. Each quantity guards against a different failure, so a loop can be only as autonomous as the weaker one allows (Figure 1 ). We derive this rule (§ 3 ), build a platform that enforces it (§ 4 ), and test the assumptions it rests on (§ 5 ), first in a case study of our platform’s own admission gate and then in controlled experiments on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench. We do not address adversarial or misaligned agents, only the ordinary failure of admitting a change that should have been rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨这个循环中有多大一部分可以在没有人类参与的情况下运行。 我们的答案建立在两个可度量的量上（§ 2）。 验证器强度衡量验证器的批准在多大程度上可以被信任：即它与参考验证器在 -1 到 1 区间上的一致程度，其中 1 表示完全一致，而总是给出相同答案的验证器得分为 0。 可恢复性衡量撤销一个坏变更的代价有多低。 它记录撤销一个变更是否需要新的验证器批准，以及旧有多少旧行为能够真正恢复。 如果没有保留旧版本的副本（例如，在原地对模型进行微调之后），撤销操作就必须通过刚刚批准了这个错误的同一个验证器。 这两个量各自防范不同的失败，因此一个循环的自主程度只能达到较弱者所允许的水平（图 1）。 我们推导这一规则（§ 3），构建一个实施该规则的平台（§ 4），并检验其所依赖的假设（§ 5），首先以我们平台自身的准入门控作为案例研究，然后在 τ²-bench 上进行受控实验。 我们不讨论对抗性或目标错位的智能体，只讨论批准了一个本应被拒绝的变更这种普通失败。

paragraphs.en: Our main contribution is a method: the two definitions, how to measure them, and the rule they support. (i) Two measurable preconditions for unattended changes, and a rule that refuses whenever either is unmeasured (§ 2 , § 3 ). (ii) A platform that enforces the rule by typing changes by recoverability, declaring verifiers as resources, and recording refusal as its own outcome (§ 4 ). (iii) Tests of the rule’s assumptions: a case study of silent gate collapse in our platform’s own admission gate, with two tests that catch it (§ 5.1 ), and experiments that vary each quantity separately for prompt edits on two τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench domains (§ 5.2 ). Our verdicts for tool, skill and weight changes follow from the definitions and are not separately tested.

paragraphs.en: A change A ↦ A ′ A\mapsto A^{\prime} that the platform derives from A A ’s own traces, in the spirit of self-taught training ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) , and admits through a verifier, with no human writing it. Running example: airline traces show the agent canceling bookings without asking the user; the loop adds “confirm before any cancellation” to p p , an LLM judge approves the edit, and it goes live. We measure a step by Δ k \Delta_{k} , the change in the share of held-out tasks solved in all k k repeated trials, because a platform cares about reliability rather than best cases.

sents.en: We measure a step by Δ k \Delta_{k} , the change in the share of held-out tasks solved in all k k repeated trials, because a platform cares about reliability rather than best cases.

paragraphs.en: For a change ι \iota and its undo ι − 1 \iota^{-1} we measure three things. Re-approval g ⁡ ( ι ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } g(\iota)\in\{0,1\} records whether the way back from A ′ A^{\prime} to A A needs a new verifier approval. If the old value was kept, the undo is a plain write and g = 0 g{=}0 ; this holds for prompt and schema edits and for a retained model checkpoint. If no old value was kept, as after fine-tuning from the current checkpoint, the undo must itself be generated and approved, so g = 1 g{=}1 . Both other measures use a fixed set of probe tasks P P , scored pass or fail. Restoration fidelity ρ ⁡ ( ι ) \rho(\iota) asks whether the undo brings the old behavior back: it is the share of tasks in P P with the same outcome after the change is undone as before the change was made. Blast radius β ⁡ ( ι ) \beta(\iota) is the share of tasks in P P whose outcome changed while ι \iota was deployed, relative to the unchanged agent: what even a perfect rollback cannot recover, because those outcomes were already delivered. In our experiments (§ 5.2 ), P P is the 20 held-out test tasks for ρ \rho (the 30 training tasks for the regenerated undos) and all 50 airline tasks for β \beta . The agent and the simulated user are both stochastic, so we also run a null change (no change at all), which gives noise floors ρ 0 < 1 \rho_{0}<1 and β 0 > 0 \beta_{0}>0 ; only values beyond these floors count. Because β \beta covers only the probe tasks, it is a lower bound: real side effects such as an issued refund must be tracked at the tool boundary, where recent work locates recoverability for agents ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: A self-improvement step does two things: it decides whether to admit A → A ′ A\to A^{\prime} , and then it changes a live system. Each quantity bounds one of these failures. Verifier strength bounds the decision, because the verdict is the loop’s only evidence that A ′ A^{\prime} is better than A A ; at σ = 0 \sigma{=}0 the verdict says nothing about quality ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Recoverability bounds the change. At g = 0 g{=}0 the platform writes back the old value and pays only for the traffic served while the change was deployed, which is what β \beta measures. At g = 1 g{=}1 the old value is gone, so the way back must be regenerated and approved by the same gate that made the mistake. Neither quantity can make up for the other, so autonomy is limited by the weaker one rather than traded between them. A strong verifier cannot justify an irreversible change, since its errors would then be permanent, and easy rollback cannot justify a weak verifier, since the loop would only churn the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进步骤做两件事：它决定是否接纳 A → A ′ A\to A^{\prime}，然后改变一个在运行的系统。 每个量约束其中一种失败。 验证器的强度约束决策，因为判定结果是循环中 A ′ A^{\prime} 优于 A A 的唯一证据；在 σ = 0 \sigma{=}0 时，判定结果对质量不作任何说明（Zheng et al., 2023）。 可恢复性约束变更。 在 g = 0 g{=}0 时，平台回写旧值，并且只需为变更部署期间所服务的流量付费，这正是 β \beta 所度量的。 在 g = 1 g{=}1 时，旧值已不存在，因此回退路径必须重新生成，并由造成错误的同一个关卡批准。 这两个量都无法弥补对方，因此自主性受较弱一方的限制，而不是在两者之间进行权衡。 强验证器无法为不可逆的变更辩护，因为其错误将永久存在；而容易回滚也不能为弱验证器辩护，因为循环只会让智能体原地打转。

paragraphs.en: The rule rests on three assumptions, which § 5 tests: (a) a verifier’s strength cannot be taken for granted and must be measured; (b) a weaker verifier admits worse changes; and (c) keeping the old value makes rollback exact and losing it does not, while an admitted change still affects tasks that rollback cannot undo.
paragraphs.zh: 该规则基于三个假设，§ 5 对其进行检验：(a) 验证器的强度不能想当然，必须加以度量；(b) 较弱的验证器会放行更糟糕的更改；(c) 保留旧值可以保证回滚是精确的，而丢失旧值则不然，同时被放行的更改仍会影响回滚无法撤销的任务。

paragraphs.en: Our platform improves deployed agents from their own production traces. For each agent it (1) collects execution traces and classifies failures, such as a wrong tool sequence, outdated knowledge or a degraded prompt; (2) maps each failure to a change along one of four dimensions: rewriting the system prompt, fixing a tool definition, updating a skill, or fine-tuning a small model on distilled traces; (3) builds the candidate and evaluates it; and (4) promotes it or stops. Each attempt runs as a recorded session, so every deployed change can be traced back to the evidence that admitted it, as in production ML pipelines ( Baylor et al., 2017 ) . We built this loop to enforce the rule; three design choices put the rule into it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的平台利用智能体自身的生产轨迹来改进已部署的智能体。 对于每个智能体，它（1）收集执行轨迹并对失败进行分类，例如错误的工具序列、过时的知识或退化的提示词；（2）将每个失败映射到以下四个维度之一上的变更：重写系统提示词、修复工具定义、更新技能，或在蒸馏出的轨迹上微调小模型；（3）构建候选变更并进行评估；（4）采纳该变更或停止。 每次尝试都以记录会话的形式运行，因此每个已部署的变更都可以追溯到使其得以通过的依据，如同生产级机器学习流水线（Baylor et al., 2017）。 我们构建这一循环正是为了执行该规则；三项设计选择将该规则落实其中。

sents.zh: 每次尝试都以记录会话的形式运行，因此每个已部署的变更都可以追溯到使其得以通过的依据，如同生产级机器学习流水线（Baylor et al., 2017）。

sents.en: We built this loop to enforce the rule; three design choices put the rule into it.
sents.zh: 我们构建这一循环正是为了执行该规则；三项设计选择将该规则落实其中。

paragraphs.en: An agent can be changed in four ways — weights, system prompt, tool definitions and skills — and each is a separate resource type that records how it is undone and hence its g g (App. C ). This lets “may this proceed without a human?” have a different answer for each type (Figure 2 ). Prompt, tool-schema and skill edits are undone by a write and may promote automatically. Weight updates can be undone by re-pinning the previous adapter, but their verifier is a learned judge of the kind § 5.1 shows can fail silently, so they need human sign-off. A training-data filter with no workable verifier ships disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以通过四种方式被更改——权重、系统提示词、工具定义和技能——每一种都是独立的资源类型，记录其如何被撤销，即其撤销方式（附录 C）。 这使得“这是否可以在没有人类的情况下继续进行？”对每种类型有不同的答案（图 2）。 提示词、工具模式（schema）和技能的编辑通过写入操作来撤销，并可能自动提升。 权重更新可以通过重新固定（re-pinning）先前的适配器来撤销，但其验证器是 §5.1 所示的那种可能无声失效的学习型裁判，因此它们需要人工签署批准。 没有可行验证器的训练数据过滤器默认禁用上线。

paragraphs.en: This case study tests assumption (a), that a verifier’s strength must be measured rather than assumed. Before our platform fine-tunes a model, it collects agent traces into a training set, and an LLM-judge gate scores the set’s diversity; a set that scores too low is not used for training. This gate is a verifier in the sense of § 2 : it decides whether a change, here a weight update, may proceed. It had been treated as working because it always returned a score. (A second gate, which filters individual training rows, ships disabled; App. A .)
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究检验假设 (a)，即验证器的强度必须经过测量，而不能凭假设认定。 在我们的平台对模型进行微调之前，它会将智能体轨迹收集成训练集，并由一个 LLM 评审门控对该集的多样性打分；得分过低的集合不会被用于训练。 该门控是 § 2 意义上的一个验证器：它决定某项变更（此处为一次权重更新）能否继续进行。 此前它被视为正常工作，因为它总是能返回一个分数。 （第二个门控，用于过滤单条训练数据行，默认处于禁用状态；见附录 A。）

paragraphs.en: The gate’s LLM judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) scores the training set from 0 to 1. Its prompt asks for two things: reward breadth (many distinct seed tasks) and penalize imbalance (a few seeds dominating); the input gives the imbalance as a number. We tested 3 judge models, 4 prompt variants, 4 imbalance levels, breadths 3–12 and two agent configurations: 172 settings of 10 runs each. In the deployed setting the gate ignores imbalance completely. It returned 0.250 in all 40 runs with zero spread, exactly what it returns when every mention of imbalance is removed from the prompt. This is not an artifact of greedy decoding, since 98 of the 172 settings vary. Full collapse, the same score at all four imbalance levels, occurs in 9 of 37 configurations, all on the deployed judge, the smallest of the three. That judge also ran most configurations (33 of 37), so the count alone does not implicate it; a matched comparison does: on identical inputs the deployed judge stays flat while both larger judges track imbalance ( p < 10 − 11 p<10^{-11} each; App. A ).
paragraphs.zh: 该门控的 LLM 评判模型（Zheng et al., 2023）对训练集打分，分值范围为 0 到 1。 其提示词要求两点：奖励广度（多个不同的种子任务）并惩罚不均衡（少数种子占主导）；输入以数字形式给出不均衡程度。 我们测试了 3 个评判模型、4 种提示词变体、4 个不均衡水平、3–12 的广度以及两种智能体配置：共 172 种设置，每种设置运行 10 次。 在部署设定中，该门控完全忽略不均衡。 它在全部 40 次运行中都返回 0.250，且零方差，这正是当提示词中所有关于不均衡的内容都被移除后它所返回的值。 这并非贪心解码造成的假象，因为 172 种设置中有 98 种的结果存在差异。 完全坍缩（在所有四个不均衡水平上得分相同）出现在 37 种配置中的 9 种里，且全部发生在部署的评判模型上，即三者中最小的一个。 该评判模型也运行了最多的配置（37 种中的 33 种），因此仅凭数量并不能归咎于它；而匹配比较则可以：在相同输入下，部署的评判模型保持不变，而两个更大的评判模型都能跟踪不均衡（各自 p < 10 − 11 p<10^{-11}；见附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: Two cheap tests catch this, each costing a handful of calls, and both belong in the platform. Delete the signal: remove the property the gate claims to measure and check that its score changes. Check the guarantees: verify that request-level settings the gate relies on actually took effect; three of ours did not, forced tool calls among them (App. B ). What did work was stating the criterion as a checkable bound: “if the largest seed exceeds 50%, score at most 0.10” held in all 16 settings above 50%, where the original wording never scored that low (30 of 30 runs vs. 0 of 30 on matched inputs, Fisher p < 10 − 16 p<10^{-16} ; Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两个低成本的测试可以捕捉到这一点，每个只需少量调用，且两者都应纳入平台。 删除信号：移除门控声称度量的属性，检查其分数是否变化。 检查保证：验证门控所依赖的请求级设置是否真正生效；我们的设置中有三个并未生效，其中包括强制工具调用（附录 B）。 真正有效的是把判据表述为可检验的界限：“若最大种子超过 50%，则得分至多为 0.10”这一表述在所有超过 50% 的 16 个设置中均成立，而原始措辞从未得到过如此低的分数（在匹配输入上为 30 次运行中 30 次对 0 次，Fisher 检验 p < 10^{-16}；表 4）。

paragraphs.en: We use the airline domain: 50 tasks split 30 for training and 20 for testing, with natural-language assertions on every task, so a program verifier and an LLM judge score the same trajectories, the comparison § 5.1 could not make in production. The reference verifier combines database-state equality with communication checks; the latter apply to only 4 of 80 test trajectories, so on the other 76 the reference is database equality alone. The loop is ours, reduced to one recipe: read failed training trajectories, propose a system-prompt revision, admit it if the verifier under test prefers it, and measure the result on the test split with the reference verifier. We report mean pass rate rather than pass k \mathrm{pass}^{k} , which at four trials discards partial credit. A1 measures σ \sigma for real verifiers; A2 tests whether lower σ \sigma picks worse changes; B fixes the verifier at the reference and compares restoring a stored copy ( g = 0 g{=}0 ) with regenerating the undo ( g = 1 g{=}1 ). Weight updates are not tested. Each agent is run twice per training task and four times per test task. Intervals are 95 % 95\% task-resampling bootstrap intervals (App. D ), paired for differences ( Miller, 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: Production ML platforms made training and serving platform services ( Baylor et al., 2017 ; Breck et al., 2019 ; Moritz et al., 2018 ; Sculley et al., 2015 ) , but not deciding what to change in a deployed agent. Self-improvement and prompt-optimization methods ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ) supply the changes we schedule but assume a trustworthy verifier; work on reward gaming and LLM judges questions that assumption ( Skalse et al., 2022 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) , and verifiable-reward methods avoid it ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2026 ) . Deployment engineering gates changes on measured evidence ( Humble & Farley, 2010 ; Beyer et al., 2016 ; Kubernetes, 2026 ) but assumes a human author. Closest is off-policy evaluation, which promotes only when a lower confidence bound beats the incumbent ( Thomas et al., 2015 ; Thomas & Brunskill, 2016 ; Sakhi et al., 2024 ) ; σ \sigma plays that role where no unbiased value estimate exists.
paragraphs.zh: 生产级机器学习平台解决了训练与服务平台服务的问题（Baylor et al., 2017；Breck et al., 2019；Moritz et al., 2018；Sculley et al., 2015），但未解决如何决定更改已部署的智能体中的什么内容。 自我改进与提示词优化方法（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023；Zelikman et al., 2022；Khattab et al., 2024）提供了我们所调度的更改，但假设存在一个可信的验证器；关于奖励博弈与 LLM 评判者的研究对这一假设提出了质疑（Skalse et al., 2022；Gao et al., 2023；Zheng et al., 2023），而可验证奖励方法则规避了这一问题（Lambert et al., 2025；Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2026）。 部署工程以测得的证据来把关更改（Humble & Farley, 2010；Beyer et al., 2016；Kubernetes, 2026），但假设由人类来编写更改。 最接近的是离线策略评估，它只有在置信下界超过现任方案时才进行提升（Thomas et al., 2015；Thomas & Brunskill, 2016；Sakhi et al., 2024）；σ \sigma 在不存在无偏价值估计的场合扮演了这一角色。

sents.zh: 部署工程以测得的证据来把关更改（Humble & Farley, 2010；Beyer et al., 2016；Kubernetes, 2026），但假设由人类来编写更改。

sents.en: Closest is off-policy evaluation, which promotes only when a lower confidence bound beats the incumbent ( Thomas et al., 2015 ; Thomas & Brunskill, 2016 ; Sakhi et al., 2024 ) ; σ \sigma plays that role where no unbiased value estimate exists.
sents.zh: 最接近的是离线策略评估，它只有在置信下界超过现任方案时才进行提升（Thomas et al., 2015；Thomas & Brunskill, 2016；Sakhi et al., 2024）；σ \sigma 在不存在无偏价值估计的场合扮演了这一角色。

paragraphs.en: The rule comes from one platform and was applied after the fact; only prompt edits were tested end to end, on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench airline and retail rather than in production; and experiment A was too small to confirm the σ \sigma effect (App. D ).
paragraphs.zh: 该规则来自单一平台，并且是事后应用的；仅在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 的 airline 和 retail 环境上对提示词修改进行了端到端测试，而非在生产环境中进行；此外，实验 A 的规模太小，无法确认 σ \sigma 效应（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: A self-improvement loop may run without a human only where the old version is kept and the verifier’s strength is measured; where either is missing, the platform should refuse.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自我改进循环只有在对旧版本予以保留并测量验证器强度的情况下，才能在没有人类参与的情况下运行；若缺少其中任一条件，平台应予以拒绝。

paragraphs.en: A training set is built from a few seed tasks ; the number of distinct seed tasks is its breadth , and the share of examples coming from the most common seed task is its imbalance . We sent the production diversity gate, with its production prompt, training sets whose imbalance we set by hand, holding everything else fixed (number and quality of examples, agent, task list). Each setting was run 10 times. The runs came in five batches (Table 5 ): 172 settings and 1,720 calls, of which 1,718 returned a score (the two others answered in plain text when the scoring tool was offered but not required). The script and data are available from the authors on request.

paragraphs.en: The judge models do not let us set the sampling temperature, so every call used the provider’s default. Scores vary from run to run in 98 of the 172 settings, so a score that never changes is not explained by deterministic decoding. We call a configuration collapsed when it gives the same score at all four imbalance levels. Nine of 37 configurations collapsed, all with the production judge. That judge was also used in 33 of the 37 configurations, so this count on its own is not significant (Fisher exact test, p = 0.55 p{=}0.55 ). The stronger evidence is batch A, which gives all three judges identical inputs: at breadth 3 the production judge returns the same score at every imbalance level, while both larger judges change their score with imbalance ( p < 10 − 11 p<10^{-11} each). Collapse also depends on the agent: the six-tool agent tracks imbalance perfectly at breadth 3 but collapses at breadths 4, 5 and 8.
paragraphs.zh: 评审模型不允许我们设置采样温度，因此每次调用都使用提供商的默认值。 在 172 个设置中有 98 个的分数随运行而变化，因此分数从不变化并不能用确定性解码来解释。 我们将一个配置在所有四个不平衡水平上都给出相同分数的情况称为坍缩。 37 个配置中有 9 个发生坍缩，且全部使用生产评审模型。 该评审模型也被用于 37 个配置中的 33 个，因此仅凭这一计数并不显著（Fisher 精确检验，p = 0.55 p{=}0.55）。 更有力的证据是批次 A，它给所有三个评审模型相同的输入：在广度为 3 时，生产评审模型在每个不平衡水平上都返回相同分数，而两个更大的评审模型的分数都随不平衡而变化（各自 p < 10 − 11 p<10^{-11}）。 坍缩还取决于智能体：六工具智能体在广度为 3 时能完美跟踪不平衡，但在广度为 4、5 和 8 时发生坍缩。

paragraphs.en: Here we hid the old prompt, as when a fine-tuned model’s previous version is gone, and asked the optimizer to write an undo. It wrote three. We compared each with the original agent on the 30 training tasks, against a floor measured with the same two runs per task ( ρ 0 = 0.98 \rho_{0}{=}0.98 ). The three undos reach ρ \rho of 0.75, 0.83 and 0.90, that is, 0.23, 0.15 and 0.08 below the floor (one-sided p = 0.0005 p{=}0.0005 , 0.004 and 0.04, all still significant after Holm’s correction for testing three); together, 0.16 below (CI [ 0.07 , 0.27 ] [0.07,0.27] , p = 0.0001 p{=}0.0001 ). So a regenerated undo does not bring the original behavior back, while a saved copy does; the two differ by about 0.16. Three caveats: these runs use the training tasks, not the test tasks used for the saved copy; the gate refused all three undos, so this shows what would have happened had one been installed; and the three are close rewrites of one another, so they test one kind of undo rather than many. The gate refused them because their training pass rates (0.567, 0.517, 0.517) were below the original’s (0.617), though that gap is too small to be significant ( − 0.05 -0.05 , CI [ − 0.23 , 0.13 ] [-0.23,0.13] ).

paragraphs.en: A verifier with σ = 0 \sigma{=}0 picks a candidate at random, so the most it can lose is the gap between the average candidate and the one a perfect verifier would pick. paragraphs.en: The winner’s-curse part can be removed by promoting a candidate on the lower end of its confidence interval rather than on its best training score ( Thomas et al., 2015 ; Thomas & Brunskill, 2016 ; Sakhi et al., 2024 ) , or reduced with statistical corrections for selecting the best of several ( Andrews et al., 2024 ; Efron, 2011 ; Zöllner & Pritchard, 2007 ) . The part that affects every candidate needs a set of test tasks the gate never uses for selection. We recommend both; we have not yet compared them on our data.
paragraphs.zh: 赢家诅咒的部分可以通过根据候选者置信区间较低的一端而非其最佳训练分数来进行晋升来消除（Thomas et al., 2015；Thomas & Brunskill, 2016；Sakhi et al., 2024），或者通过针对从多个选项中挑选最优者的统计校正来减少（Andrews et al., 2024；Efron, 2011；Zöllner & Pritchard, 2007）。 影响所有候选者的那一部分则需要一组从不用于筛选的测试任务。 我们建议两者兼用；我们尚未在自己的数据上对二者进行比较。
